name: 49841 · Gwinn, MI
findings: ZIP 49841 (Gwinn) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49841 (Gwinn) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
